task.description:
Design ISS-501..504. Write FOUR Type E prose design docs. Read first: docs/requirements/BPM_Architecture_Backlog.20260611.md (ISS-501..504), src/api/middleware/tenant_context.zig, src/db/*, src/admin/tenant_migration.zig, src/db/provisioning.zig, templates/lego-catalog.md.

1. src/design/iss501_storage_mode_routing.md — ISS-501:
   Resolve read/write authority from public.tenants.storage_mode (ISS-107 added the column).
   During SPT coexistence, each tenant is served by exactly ONE path:
   - LEGACY_RLS → search_path=public + RLS predicate (bpm.tenant_id session var)
   - SCHEMA → search_path=tenant_{slug}
   Tenant-context resolution (§11.2) reads storage_mode once per request and pins routing.
   No request mixes read on one path and write on the other.
   Touchpoints: src/api/middleware/tenant_context.zig (or equivalent), src/db/*

2. src/design/iss502_spt_cutover.md — ISS-502:
   SPT cutover transaction (SPT-02): copy rows from public into tenant schema, verify parity (row counts + checksums), flip public.tenants.storage_mode to SCHEMA atomically inside a single transaction. Failure → rollback, tenant stays in LEGACY_RLS (safe). Idempotent: re-run on already-migrated tenant is no-op.
   Touchpoints: src/admin/tenant_migration.zig

3. src/design/iss503_rls_removal.md — ISS-503:
   Remove legacy tenant_id/RLS predicates (SPT-03). Guard: only proceed when no tenant remains in LEGACY_RLS mode. Drop RLS policies, tenant_id predicates from all tables. Remove bpm.tenant_id session var usage. GBL-077 teardown referenced.
   Touchpoints: migrations/, store modules

4. src/design/iss504_migration_tracking.md — ISS-504:
   Reconcile §5 schema + per-tenant migration tracking (SPT-04). public.schema_migrations tracks GBL- migrations. Each tenant_{slug}.schema_migrations tracks per-tenant migrations. Provisioning a new tenant records its per-tenant migration state in its own schema. ADP-12 default-tenant regression updated and green.
   Touchpoints: src/db/provisioning.zig, test suite

No implementation code. Prose signatures and behaviour only.
acceptance_criteria: iss501: storage_mode routing, search_path pinning, no cross-path mixing described
iss502: cutover transaction with copy+verify+flip, atomic, rollback-safe, idempotent described
iss503: RLS/predicate removal guard, migration approach, teardown sequence described
iss504: dual schema_migrations tracking, per-tenant ledger on provision described
No implementation code in any doc
